findings.detail: .dockerignore does not explicitly exclude the `keypair/` directory. While Dockerfile COPY commands do not copy it, defense-in-depth requires an explicit exclusion. A future COPY change or wildcard could accidentally bake the keypair into the image layer. Add `keypair/` to .dockerignore.

.gitignore does not exclude the `keypair/` directory. The keypair file is `id.json` which does not match any existing gitignore pattern (*.key, *.pem, credentials.json, secrets/). Running `git add .` could accidentally commit the keypair to the repository.

nginx.conf is missing entirely. Cannot verify that /admin/stats is blocked. This is a required file for task 7 and a security-critical configuration (Decision 13 in tech-spec). Without nginx.conf, the /admin/stats endpoint may be proxied and accessible.
findings.fix: Create nginx.conf that proxies only /mcp, /chat, /download-knowledge, /health and returns 403 or 404 for /admin/stats

findings.detail: ollama/Dockerfile is missing. docker-compose.yml references `build: context: ./ollama dockerfile: Dockerfile` but the file does not exist. The compose file will fail on `docker compose up`. This also means the pre-pull strategy and warm-up request (Decision 11) cannot be verified.
findings.fix: Create ollama/Dockerfile with pre-pull of qwen2.5:3b and warm-up entrypoint

passed.detail: nginx exposes 80 and 443 only. mcp service has no ports mapping (internal only). ollama service has no ports mapping (internal only).
All three services share the `mnemonic` bridge network. No cross-network exposure. mcp and ollama are unreachable from outside Docker.

No hardcoded credentials, tokens, or private keys. Sensitive config uses environment variable references with ${VAR:-default} pattern. MNEMONIC_KEYPAIR_PATH references a volume-mounted path, not a secret value.
ollama service has no `ports:` section. Port 11434 is only accessible within the mnemonic Docker network.

summary: 4 blocking findings: (1) .dockerignore missing explicit keypair/ exclusion risks keypair baking into image layers; (2) .gitignore missing keypair/ exclusion risks accidental commit of the keypair file id.json; (3) nginx.conf is absent -- /admin/stats block and proxy restrictions cannot be verified; (4) ollama/Dockerfile is absent -- compose will fail on build. Compose structure is otherwise sound: read-only keypair mount, correct port exposure (80/443 only), network isolation, no hardcoded secrets, Ollama not externally accessible. Resolve all 4 findings before re-review.
